Tonsillolith: The patient has a history of odynophagia and a persistent sensation of a foreign body in his throat following fish-bone impaction. The examination revealed a protruding lesion through the right palatine tonsil, which was hard, mobile, well-delineated, nontender, and yellowish-white in color. The lateral neck radiograph showed a uniform, ovoid calcification overlying the right tonsillar region, suggesting a tonsillolith.
